source_text.ISS-0987: queue Q-954 / GH #2209: config/runtime.exs:63 compares secrets_master_key to <<0xFF::256>> (integer 255) instead of 32 bytes of 0xFF.

task.description: WF-03 Step 2b hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's design for ISS-0987/Q-954.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers the issue fix, regression test and req190 doc fix
Scope limited to the literal; pepper block untouched
No implementation code beyond the literal
Test plan unambiguous and fail-first sound; no key echo

result.summary: Validated lib/letflow/design/iss0987-secrets-master-key-0xff-literal.md against the ISS-0987 issue text (origin/docs/ISS-0987-secrets-master-key-0xff-literal), the step-01 diagnosis and the real files. Verified in config/runtime.exs: line 63 is 'if secrets_master_key == <<0::256>> or secrets_master_key == <<0xFF::256>> do' (dead second operand); the raise at 63-68 names LETFLOW_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY and the class of value only, never interpolating the key; the pepper block's all-0xFF check at line 109 already uses :binary.copy(<<0xFF>>, 32) and its pepper==master-key guard is at line 116, so the design's 'do not touch pepper' scope is right; ld_pepper (lines 90-107) raises 'is missing' when the pepper var is absent, confirming the masking trap (all-0xFF key without pepper vars exits non-zero for the wrong reason), and the design's valid distinct pepper pair plus message assertion handles it; the pepper block follows the key check (line 72 onward), so a fixed key check fires before pepper validation. Verified lib/letflow/design/req190-secrets-core.md section 2 item 4 (lines 199-203) carries the false 'wrapped 32 bytes of 0xFF' literal that Change B corrects. Coverage: Change A (fix), Change B (req190 doc), Change C (3 regression tests: zeros refused, 64xf refused fail-first with message assertion, valid key accepted) map to every issue requirement via the section 5 table. No TBD/deferral (section 6: none). Only code in the design is the one-token literal :binary.copy(<<0xFF>>, 32); no function bodies. Test plan specifies env (MIX_ENV dev, MIX_TEST_PARTITION and MIX_BUILD_PATH nil), pepper pair, marker, exact assertions, full-length no-echo refute, and mutation procedure restricted to a throwaway worktree. Not run: no tests executed (design only; tests do not exist yet).

issues.description: Design says the shared env uses MIX_ENV=dev for all three new cases, while the existing malformed-key test uses MIX_ENV=test. Intentional and correct (dev has no test.exs fallback and the pepper vars are required in non-test envs), but ELIXIR-DEV must not copy the existing test's env. Case 3 (valid key, exit 0) under dev with --no-start depends on config/dev.exs not requiring Postgres at boot; the diagnosis reproduced exit 0 with the marker in exactly this setup, so it is expected to hold.

Exact pepper hex ('ab' x 32) and valid-key hex are given as examples, not fixed. Any 64-lowercase-hex values distinct from each other and from all-0/all-f satisfy the design; the key must not equal the pepper (runtime.exs:116).

result.next_action: ORCH: proceed to ELIXIR-DEV with the design (Changes A, B, C); SECURITY-REVIEWER applies (secrets path).
